A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study despite the changed title. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices A–G support comparison. Ambiguities in the revised Figure 3 are reporting issues, not extraction gaps.

before.justification: V1 reports original image-jailbreak optimization and transfer experiments across more than 40 VLMs, including training-data, training-stage, checkpoint, and ensemble comparisons.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and their empirical results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The image-optimization objective, frozen VLMs, gradient-based attack procedure, and Adam optimization remain unchanged in Section 2 and Appendix C.

E1.justification: Both versions use AdvBench, Anthropic HHH, and the Generated dataset, retaining the same harmful-request coverage and VLM training-data scenarios. No new dataset or task is documented.

E2.justification: No competing attack method or baseline is introduced or removed. The unoptimized-image comparisons and Appendix B.1 comparison concerning Niu et al. are retained. Unclear ensemble configurations in Figure 3 do not establish a new comparison method.

E3.justification: The stated splits, metrics, optimization budget, and three eight-VLM ensembles remain unchanged. However, v2 Figure 3 contains four unlabeled panels and many more observations without explaining their configurations or aggregation. The PDFs do not establish whether an experimental setting changed.

E4.justification: The documented analyses of initialization, model backbones, overlapping training data, training stages, checkpoints, and ensemble size are retained. Figure 7 adds summary panels for the existing checkpoint analysis rather than documenting a new ablation.

E5.justification: No new seed information, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests are reported. Appendix B.1 retains the same discussion of sampling variability; the additional Figure 3 points are not explained as uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: The retained main plots, quoted numerical findings, and appendix results match. Figure 3 changes from three labeled ensemble series to four unlabeled scatter panels with many more observations. Their correspondence to earlier runs is unspecified, preventing a reliable distinction between redisplayed, additional, and revised results.

T1.justification: Section 5 adds a rough combinatorial calculation comparing V^N possible text strings with 256^(512×512×3) images. This is a limited mathematical argument supporting a conjecture, not a theorem or proof about transferability.

C1.justification: The new title emphasizes failure to transfer, but the abstract, introduction, and concluding findings retain the same claims: strong white-box jailbreaks, little general transfer, and improved transfer between highly similar VLMs.

C2.justification: V2 adds the conjecture that the much larger image search space leaves optimization insufficiently constrained, potentially explaining rapid jailbreaking and poor transfer. It consequently suggests constraints, regularization, or improved optimization, supplementing v1's connector-focused interpretation.

D1.justification: V1 Figure 3 explicitly lists the constituent models of the three attacked ensembles. V2 removes these lists without providing an equivalent specification elsewhere. Appendix C's implementation details and the model-release information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are retained, including the detailed related-work appendices. The expanded Many-shot Jailbreaking reference updates publication metadata for an already cited work.

P1.justification: V2 changes the title, separates Discussion and Future Research Directions into numbered sections, and makes localized prose, caption, acknowledgment, and typographical edits. Most of the narrative remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1's panel framing is redrawn; Figure 3 replaces the categorical final-score display with initial-versus-final scatter panels; Figure 7 gains two checkpoint-summary panels. Figure 6 and surrounding text shift position, while appendix displays remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added discussion and checkpoint summaries offer modest benefits, but Figure 3 loses explicit ensemble specifications and shows four unlabeled panels while its caption and Section 3.2 still describe three ensembles. This makes a central experiment harder to interpret and reproduce, producing a limited overall decline in reporting quality despite the retained scientific core.
